mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in retail sales signals a weakening consumer sector that will drag on corporate earnings and equity prices, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day SPX returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal

mechanism_narrative: An accelerating industrial production index signals strengthening economic momentum that will boost corporate earnings and equity prices, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day SPX returns are negative in > 40% of months with accelerating IP
